title: Seeing how @dogtrax is responding to @ShawnaCoppola book in comic I decided to try found poems as respons to "An Open Life Joseph Campbell inConversation with Michael Toms" #smalllpoems
summary: We must find the poetic experience to reactivate our world the vision quest must deal with our world There is poetry in Detroit Factories Demons our limitations Devil, a god unrecognized tool of power only you can take a demon and turn him to your protector repressed demons become your monster follow your bliss not instructions
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We must find
the poetic experience


to reactivate our world
the vision quest must
deal with our
world
There is poetry
in Detroit Factories
Demons our
limitations
Devil, a god
 unrecognized
tool of power
only you can take a
demon and turn him to
your protector
repressed demons
become your monster
follow your bliss
not instructions
